passages.text: Mendicant, give up desire for whatever’s impermanent.
passages.note: Letting go of what cannot last

passages.text: Oh! How happy are the perfected ones! Craving is not found in them, the conceit ‘I am’ is cut off, and the net of delusion is shattered. They’ve attained imperturbability, their minds are unclouded, nothing in the world clings to them, manifesting divinity, undefiled.
passages.note: The peace of freedom from craving and ego
